context: Kenji and Daichi help an elderly neighbor move heavy furniture.
purpose: Two friends helping community elder; brief practical exchange.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Warm exhalation on the opening. Strained but honest — the sound of a man assessing weight without drama. Slight groan on the lift, then a soft, friendly resignation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: On three, then. Let's get it.
lines.style: Gentle and steady. No rush in the count. Warm mentor energy — anchoring. The kind of calm that says he's done this before and trusts the person beside him.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Quick, alert attention on 「足元」. Protective without being sharp. The husbandly concern that comes from knowing how easily things go wrong in tight spaces. Stays close in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: We're good, just a bit more.
lines.style: Breathing steady even under effort. Determined but not strained. Warm reassurance — not performative, just the quiet confidence of someone who sees the finish line.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: よっしゃ、これで一段落!
lines.style: Bright, genuine relief breaks through. The laugh is in the voice. Animated, celebratory but not over-the-top — the warmth of a job well done with someone you trust.
